question: Which of the following glands/organs in human body secretes bile juice?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Liver**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Bile juice is a digestive juice secreted by the liver.__
 
• Bile is stored in the gallbladder.</span&g
